params.name: event_prefix
params.description: The prefix that will be added to the beginning of all court rule event titles

params.name: jurisdiction[id]
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Jurisdiction. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the MatterDocket records with the matching property.

params.name: service_type[id]
params.description: The unique identifier for a single ServiceType. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the MatterDocket records with the matching property.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The date the MatterDocket should start. (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: start_time
params.description: The time the MatterDocket should start. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: trigger[id]
params.description: The unique identifier for a single JurisdictionsToTrigger. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the MatterDocket records with the matching property.

info.name: Return the data for all matter dockets

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter MatterDocket records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter MatterDocket records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of MatterDocket records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the MatterDocket records with the matching property.

params.name: matter_status
params.description: Filter MatterDocket records to those with Matters having a specific status.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the MatterDocket records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `name` matching a given string.

params.name: service_type_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single ServiceType. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a MatterDocket. The list will be filtered to include only the MatterDocket records with the matching property.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter MatterDocket records to those having a specific status.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter MatterDocket records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
